versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in this release.
- Version number updated to 1.0.2.

- Added documentation for API token management, including new CLI commands to create and manage tokens.
- Updated authentication instructions to recommend generating API tokens via the CLI for agents and CI/CD workflows.
- No code changes; documentation update only.

- Removed localized documentation and configuration files: README_CN.md, package.json, and scripts/seede.sh.
- Skill renamed to "seede-design" with updated metadata for improved clarity and discoverability.
- Documentation overhauled for a CLI-focused, agent-first experience; new examples and best practices for autonomous and developer workflows.
- Clarified installation, prerequisites, and command-line usage specifically for agents and automated environments.
- Added detailed instructions for managing designs, asset integration, and enforcing brand guidelines.
- Improved advanced usage guides for integrating with agent workflows and referencing user assets.

Initial release of the seede-design skill.

- Generate professional design graphics with Seede AI via text or image prompts.
- Supports creating posters, social media graphics, UI designs, and more.
- Allows asset uploads and referencing assets in design tasks.
- Offers advanced options for brand colors and reference images.
- Detailed API usage instructions and sample workflows included.
